decision: NO CHANGE; retain batched store ownership and avoid row-at-a-time regression.
findings: Candidate symbols are fetched with one symbols_for_paths_many bounded query rather than row-at-a-time symbols_for_path calls.
The store API preserves an independent per-path symbol bound, avoiding global-LIMIT starvation.
Changing this path to per-candidate reads would regress store economics; no evidence supports a new store cache.
